CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2667 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 5d874ec6309675a391f1a97acf6e5a77781d3f78. Bus nonce: f66fc55ed0212d5c21f240fc165081f4. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 5d874ec6309675a391f1a97acf6e5a77781d3f78`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 5d874ec6309675a391f1a97acf6e5a77781d3f78` or `Fix review: blocked 5d874ec6309675a391f1a97acf6e5a77781d3f78 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: f66fc55ed0212d5c21f240fc165081f4`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `5d874ec6309675a391f1a97acf6e5a77781d3f78` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2667 5d874ec6309675a391f1a97acf6e5a77781d3f78") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2667-f66fc55e`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer for PR #2667, a roster batch (branch fix/audit-r10-roster-pr4), head 5d874ec6309675a391f1a97acf6e5a77781d3f78. It lands 23 commits from handoff/audit-r10-roster onto main 12032c43: appended carries, new groups (R10-FLY-NO-FOOTERS-PUSH-PATHS, R10-FLY-INERT-LOAD-TIME), and stage changes (R10-LOOP-CPU done at 7108101d7, and groups set in-progress). Same shape as #2655, #2661 and #2663. The only files are dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json and the delivery row dev/programme/delivery/2667.md. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md exactly, from a detached worktree at the head. Your ev/ MUST contain ev/HEAD.txt holding the full 40-hex head, or the relay refuses the verdict.

Verify:
(1) Three-dot diff: only the roster and the delivery row. Any other file blocks.
(2) Use python or jq over both rosters (it is a list of objects keyed "group"). For every changed group, classify each change: appended carry, new group, stage/resume edit, or other. "Other" (a brief rewrite, a removed carry, an after change) must be justified by a roster_edit commit message, or the PR is blocked. Each "done" stage cites a merge SHA that is on origin/main. Each new group's files exist at origin/main or on the ref its brief cites.
(3) Null control: no group is removed, and nothing main wrote to the roster since the merge base is lost. Count groups before and after.
(4) `node tools/policy/brief_lint.mjs` on the roster reports 0 errors. Record the scoped-gate MODE line. Read CI with one bulk check-runs call. The merge-tree against origin/main is clean, VERSION is untouched, and the commits carry no footers (git log --format=%B).
Rules: PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1; spare the GitHub API; no Claude footers.
